Food Delivery: An AI Agent for Ops Teams
text: This AI agent answers operations questions about 196,000 food deliveries from DoorDash’s publicly available data (early 2015). A language model reads each question and chooses a tool: for questions about past deliveries it writes and runs a SQL query; for questions about a new order it uses a delivery-time model I trained. It then explains the result in plain English.

title: Noor de Bruijn
text: I am a data scientist and consultant based in Melbourne. I recently completed my PhD research at the University of Melbourne, where I applied natural language processing (NLP) to large-scale workplace text data. I also ran my own research and analytics firm for six years, working with clients in media, market research and e-commerce. My strengths: technical depth, practical problem-solving, and clear communication.
